title: 北京马拉松官方网站
publisher: 北京马拉松组织委员会
claims: The Beijing Marathon starts on the east side of Tiananmen Square.
The 2026 course finishes in the Olympic Park central area.
The official route notice gives the 42.195 km course and city road sequence.
The 2026 official route notice follows Chang’an Avenue, Fuxing Road and Olympic West Road.
